B also shows a separate Account section whose card has a reddish border, which suggests a danger zone. A explains up front that changes save instantly, but its account deletion is not visible in the screenshot, and neither screenshot shows a 'Saved' confirmation or how quiet hours look when reminders are off. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both are well-grouped dark-theme settings pages with clear headings and plain-language switch descriptions. B is slightly ahead on rule 1 because it states that changes save immediately and shows On/Off text beside each switch. A ties quiet hours more closely to reminders by placing them directly under it, but neither screenshot shows a disabled state, and the account-deletion area is cut off in both screenshots, so items 3, 4 and 6 are scored partly on inference.
